summary: Patch release on top of 5.39.0 with one fix: the nginz chart now routes /teams/{tid}/search-visibility, so clients can reach the team search-visibility endpoint through the public API. Nothing to do before upgrading.

changes.description: The team search-visibility endpoint (/teams/{tid}/search-visibility) is now reachable through nginz, so clients can call it on the public API.

configuration.description: The default list gains /teams/([^/]*)/search-visibility$. If you override the whole list in your values, add that path to get the endpoint.
